_README: Runtime switches for the model calls that happen INSIDE a cycle.
THIS FILE IS WRITTEN BY A HUMAN AND NEVER BY THE SYSTEM. It carries no
sha256 stamp, deliberately. config/homeostasis.json is stamped because a
defended threshold must not change quietly; a routine on/off switch there
would mean re-stamping the hash every time it is flipped, and a guard that
is re-stamped routinely is a guard nobody reads.
config_expression.yaml was the other candidate and was rejected: the
cockpit rewrites it in place when the mic/camera toggles are flipped, so
Both switches default to false. They stay false until one full nightly
cycle has run clean with the cycle-end state vector in place. Each makes a
model call at every phase boundary - about 63 a night - which is the shape
It is on the protected-path denylist, so no self-generated patch can flip
these on. A human edits this file or it does not change.

reaction.what: the model is handed the raw receptor lines since the last phase boundary and answers, in its own words, what they say about its own state
reaction.cost: one model call per phase boundary, ~63 per cycle

perplexity.what: the model states its own condition from the cycle vector and the perplexity of that statement is published as a receptor
perplexity.cost: one model call per phase boundary, ~63 per cycle
